user.title: Homapel Conversation
user.description: Enter the per-unit API key generated by the Homapel installer tool to link this Home Assistant instance to the Homapel cloud. Typically seeded automatically by the installer; use this form only for manual provisioning.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by the Homapel cloud.
error.forbidden: This unit is not permitted to connect (suspended or cross-tenant).
error.timeout: Timed out contacting the Homapel cloud.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Homapel cloud.

init.title: Homapel Conversation
init.description: Tune per-installation settings. Changes apply on the next utterance.

data_description.converse_sock_read: Maximum time the cloud may go silent mid-request before the call is aborted. Bounds the model's think-time and gaps between streamed deltas; the request as a whole is unbounded so long answers won't be truncated.
data_description.unified_pipeline: Lets the cloud start generating speech while the answer is still being written, so replies begin playing sooner. Applies only to voice pipelines that use Homapel for speech-to-text, conversation and text-to-speech together; other pipelines are unaffected. Turn off to make each step wait for the previous one.
